messages:
maya (CS): Heads-up — Minigo goes live tomorrow. Account is flagged as at-risk. Need a tiny, customer-facing 1-page runbook for first 48h: prefill/poke, batching guidance, streaming sanity checks, a 3-line smoke test, and a 2-question feedback ping. Who can take this?
jin (CS): I got it. Plan: 4 bullets for customers, a one-line curl for devs, and a feedback webhook. Keep wording non-technical.
rachel (eng-runtime): I'll draft the engineer note + expectations. Minimal warmup we recommend: run 12 short warmup calls; confirm KV hit rate climbs >80%; run ~30 streamed requests at ~150ms spacing and confirm first-chunk latency <1.5s.
eden (support): Add escalation criteria: error rate >1.5% over 5m or median gen latency >2s -> open urgent ticket with trace_id + 3 sample prompts. Feedback webhook should auto-create a ticket tagged onboard/minigo.
prewarm-bot: Note: Minigo dedicated pool prewarm scheduled tonight 23:00 UTC.
jin (CS): Customer copy (very short):
- Run prefill script (12 short requests).
- Set batch_size by prompt length: short (<128 tokens) -> 32; medium (128-512) -> 8-16; long (>512) -> 4-8.
- Run quick smoke test and submit feedback.
rachel (eng-runtime): Shareable curl (engineer note):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
Expected quick checks: HTTP 200, first stream chunk <=1500ms, KV hit rate >80% after warmups. If KV stays low, increase prefill_count to 30 or extend TTL. If streaming chunks delayed, switch to non-streaming endpoint and include trace_id.
jin (CS): Feedback form (2 questions): Q1 "Did results meet expectations?" (Yes/No). Q2 "If no, brief note". Hook -> https://hooks.redwood.ai/minigo-feedback.
eden (support): We'll tag incoming tickets with onboard/minigo and notify the CSM. Include what we'll check on our side: KV priming, pool health, recent deploys.
jin (CS): I'll assemble the 1-pager + plain-text run commands and post to #customer-success and DM Minigo CSM by EOD.
maya (CS): Thanks all — short and actionable is perfect. Please paste the final engineer note here before sending.
